title: ML Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build strong software and mathematics foundations first, then progress through machine learning, deep learning, MLOps, deployment and production AI systems.

facts.Current degree: B.Tech / B.E. (CSE - Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning)
facts.Timeline assumption: Four-year B.Tech/B.E. beginning in 2026 and ending around 2030. The roadmap assumes the student wants an engineering-focused ML career rather than a purely academic research path.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Python, mathematics, statistics, data structures, machine learning, deep learning, software engineering and ML projects.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Production ML, NLP/LLMs, computer vision, recommender systems, time series or ML infrastructure.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: ML system architecture, model reliability, evaluation, MLOps, technical leadership and product integration.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: AI platform architecture, responsible AI, model governance, multimodal systems, AI strategy and research-to-production leadership.

blocks.text: Four-year honours variant

If you take the four-year honours/research variant, use the additional year for advanced deep learning, distributed ML, research, publication-quality experimentation, multimodal AI or a substantial industry ML project. Do not use the extra year only to collect certificates.
Specialisation

rows.text: Deep learning, distributed training, papers, experimentation

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Learn to build complete ML systems rather than only train models. Data quality, evaluation, inference cost, latency, security, monitoring and product impact become increasingly important as models become easier to access.

blocks.label: Career progression

blocks.text: These are typical stages, not guaranteed promotion dates.
PhD routes

Stay close to both research and production. Follow changes in model architectures and tooling, but focus on durable engineering skills: evaluation, data quality, inference systems, reliability, security, cost and deployment. A senior ML career can remain deeply technical or move toward ML architecture, research engineering, platform leadership or AI engineering management.
